convert_kosmos2_5_checkpoint: convert a Kosmos2.5 Fairseq checkpoint to a PyTorch model using the convert_kosmos2_5 script with checkpoint and output paths
rename_key_mapping: rename Fairseq checkpoint keys to HuggingFace Kosmos2.5 key names using the KEYS_TO_MODIFY_MAPPING
load_checkpoint_to_cpu: load a Fairseq checkpoint to CPU using load_checkpoint_to_cpu for Kosmos2.5 weight conversion
save_pytorch_model: save a converted Kosmos2.5 PyTorch model to a directory using save_pretrained
run_cli_conversion: run the Kosmos2.5 checkpoint conversion CLI with --kosmos2_5_checkpoint_path and --pytorch_dump_folder_path arguments
